claim: On 2024-04-12 KMS capped the extra rotation charge: before, each rotation of a KMS key added $1/month per rotation; now only the first and second rotation add $1/month.
question: How did the KMS rotation price change in 2024?

evidence.quote: Previously, each rotation of a KMS key added $1/month per rotation to a KMS customer managed key. Now, for KMS keys that you rotate automatically or on demand, the first and second rotation of the key adds $1/month (prorated hourly) in cost, but this price increase is capped at the second rotation, and all rotations after your second rotation are not billed.

changed.was: each rotation of a KMS key added $1/month per rotation

note: d055. Current truth: kms-price-rotation-capped-at-second. Evidence is the What's New API listing snapshot (the post page itself is blocked by robots.txt).

claim: On 2024-07-08 KMS increased the default request quotas for cryptographic operations with symmetric encryption, RSA, and ECC and SM2 KMS keys.
question: When and how did KMS raise its default cryptographic request quotas?

evidence.quote: | [Quota change](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/requests-per-second.html) | Increased the default cryptographic operations request rate for symmetric encryption KMS keys, RSA KMS keys, and ECC and SM2 KMS keys. | July 8, 2024 |

note: d073. Old values (symmetric 50,000 to 100,000 in the three largest Regions; RSA and ECC 500 to 1,000) appear only in the What's New post of 2024-07-22, whose page is blocked by robots.txt and whose API-listing text fails M4 (HTML escapes around the sentences), so no 'was' value is recorded. Current truth: kms-quota-request-symmetric-crypto, kms-quota-request-rsa-crypto, kms-quota-request-ecc-crypto.

claim: On 2023-05-24 AWS announced that the KMS HSMs were certified at FIPS 140-2 Security Level 3; they had been certified under FIPS 140-2 overall Security Level 2 since 2017. Today all KMS keys are protected by HSMs validated under FIPS 140-3 Security Level 3.
question: What FIPS level did KMS HSMs have before, and when did that change?

qualifiers.scope: all AWS KMS HSMs outside the China Regions

evidence.quote: AWS KMS HSMs have been certified under FIPS 140-2 overall Security Level 2 continuously since 2017.
All AWS KMS keys, regardless of their creation date or origin are automatically protected using HSMs that have been validated under FIPS 140-3 Security Level 3.

note: d003. The 2023-05-24 date and the Level 3 upgrade come from the What's New listing title (the post page is blocked by robots.txt); the quoted sentence gives the old level. The date KMS reached FIPS 140-3 Level 3 is not stated in any saved page. Current truth: kms-hsm-fips-140-3-level-3.
